title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use blue, green and black bars on a light background; some colour-blind users cannot tell the crank from the coupler.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or line styles that keep the four bars distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Bars distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: free the rocker and the foot
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The mini-project of Session 3 fixes c = d and k = 2; a wider search finds flatter legs that also lift the foot more.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a steady-speed measure to the leg search
body:
## Problem
The foot nearly stops at both ends of the stance, so a body riding on it would surge.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. Session 3 has `stance_speed_spread`, which shows the problem (2.21 for our leg).

## Expected outcome
A search that trades stance deviation against speed uniformity, with a plot of the best trade-offs.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A leg with spread at most 2.0 and deviation below 4 percent of the stride
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a multi-legged walker
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a six-legged walker with traced foot paths and a straightness map; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A walker with at least 6 legs and at least 3 feet on the ground at every instant
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
